items.a: Yes. AGPL-3.0-licensed, self-hosted, no paid tier. The only thing you pay for is your own server (or run it on a Raspberry Pi).

Bambu Lab X1 (X1C, X1E), H2 (H2D, H2D Pro, H2C, H2S), P1 (P1P, P1S), P2 (P2S), A1 (A1, A1 mini), A2 (A2L) and X2 (X2D). Anything that exposes the standard Bambu MQTT and FTP endpoints with Developer Mode enabled.

items.q: Do I need to expose it to the internet?
items.a: No. The web UI runs on your local network. The Telegram bot reaches Telegram's API outbound - no inbound port required.
Not any more. BamDude forked from Bambuddy 2.2.2 and the two have diverged too far for a one-time import; start with an empty data directory and re-add your printers and spools.
Strictly local. BamDude talks to your printers over your LAN using Developer Mode. No cloud calls except optional Obico AI failure detection (opt-in).
Yes. SQLite is the default for the easy path; switch to Postgres via DATABASE_URL when your archive grows.

items.q: Will my Telegram chat get spammed?
items.a: You configure per-chat notification settings, quiet hours, and event types. Defaults are conservative.
